sectionHeading: What the Body Reveals That the Will Cannot Conceal
authority: Editorial craft owned by the editorial agent under author delegation. Whether the body can be gamed is the central empirical dispute in the volume and belongs to the author.

terms: for the first time in human history
ledgerSearch.outcome: No recorded decision governs this section's central claim. The wave-one review's scientific posture paragraph is a summary characterization, not an itemized decision, so under the correction and obligation boundary it does not override the baseline. The claim that no act of will can reliably fabricate the difference in real time is therefore restored at full baseline strength, and the shipped paragraph that contradicts it is not merged in. The volume card's known weak passages name inference from physiology to moral truth, so one guard against that inference is kept.

findings.summary: Substitution by adjacent truth, in its purest form found so far. The shipped section replaces the volume's central physiological claim with its direct negation, using only true sentences.

evidence.baseline: The body cannot strategize in the same way. This is the central physiological fact on which Providence rests. ... there is no act of will that can reliably fabricate the difference in real time.
evidence.shipped: They are not immune to training or strategy. Breath can alter heart rate variability. Speakers can change pace and pitch. Medication, disability, illness, fatigue, environment, and culture all affect the same signals. The body is harder to script completely than a profile, but it is not a transparent transcript of character.

findings.diagnosis: Every sentence in the shipped paragraph is true. Breath does alter heart rate variability. Medication and culture do affect these signals. And together they assert the opposite of what the section exists to establish, which is that the body cannot be strategically composed in real time. A reviewer checking Part Three for false statements would pass this paragraph without pausing. Name the category: substitution by adjacent truth. It is the hardest failure to catch and the most damaging, because the replacement is defensible in every particular and wrong in aggregate. Restored at full baseline strength; the contradiction is flagged, not merged.

findings.summary: The cautious half law again, and here the committing half is the section's title.

evidence.baseline: The vagus nerve does not perform. The radial pulse does not know it is being observed.

findings.diagnosis: Fourth confirmation in Part Three. The section is titled for what the will cannot conceal, and the shipped version deletes both sentences that say anything is concealed from the will, retitling itself What the Body Contributes. The heading diagnostic and the cautious half law point at the same two sentences. These are also the section's only images, and the volume card asks that sustained abstraction return to a body.

findings.summary: The display claim was removed, and with it the section's statement of what is newly possible.

evidence.baseline: *It is now possible, for the first time in human history, to ground social trust in physiological reality, not to replace the felt sense of trust, but to give it a substrate of verification that makes it harder to counterfeit and easier to develop.*

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the wave-one narrowing of priority claims.
findings.diagnosis: The line is the section's result and it carries its own limit in the same breath: not to replace the felt sense of trust, but to give it a substrate. That qualification is what keeps the claim from being a claim that machines can adjudicate trust, and removing the whole line removed the qualification along with the assertion.

evidence.baseline: the level of behavior and self-report, The autonomic nervous system fenced around its definition, and to ground social trust in physiological reality.

findings.diagnosis: One introduced a specification of what behavior and self-report means and became a colon. One fenced a four-item definition between a subject and its verb and was rebuilt as a compound predicate, so the system governs and then operates. One preceded a not-but adverbial that is grammatically dependent and carries no internal comma, and became a comma.

debtImpact.effect: reopened by restoration at full strength
debtImpact.note: The autonomic nervous system operating largely below conscious control, the HRV signal differing between genuine and performed connection, and the claim that no act of will can reliably fabricate that difference in real time, all return exactly as the baseline states them. This is the single most consequential unverified empirical claim in the volume and the whole anti-counterfeiting argument depends on it. Not softened. Flagged.

One guard is kept in adapted form: Providence does not measure wisdom, virtue, goodness, or the depth of a soul, and a regulated nervous system can belong to a manipulative person. It does not weaken the physiological claim and it blocks the inference from physiology to moral worth that the volume card names among the known weak passages.
Every previous attempt to measure human trustworthiness or reputation, and for the first time in human history, are both restored. The second is the exact phrase the item's title names.
This is the central physiological fact on which Providence rests names the dependency in the volume's own words.

reasoning.note: The behavior and self-report argument with its three gameable examples, the body cannot strategize claim, the central physiological fact, the autonomic definition, the vagus and radial pulse pair, the HRV difference between genuine and performed connection, and the display line with its internal limit.

A shortened form of the shipped guard against moral inference: Providence does not measure wisdom, virtue, goodness, or the depth of a soul, and a regulated nervous system can belong to a manipulative person. Retained under R-VOICE-BIND because the volume card names this inference among the known weak passages, and because it qualifies who the body's evidence is about rather than how reliable the evidence is.

The shipped paragraph beginning They are not immune to training or strategy. It is true in every particular and it directly contradicts the claim this section exists to make. Merging both would leave the manuscript asserting and denying the same proposition two paragraphs apart. The contradiction is recorded in openQuestions instead.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT across three marks, as recorded in F4.

openQuestions: Direct contradiction, and the sharpest one in the volume. Baseline: there is no act of will that can reliably fabricate the difference in real time. Shipped: they are not immune to training or strategy, and breath can alter heart rate variability. Both cannot stand. The baseline claim is restored because it is the author's and because CTD-0009 is an obligation rather than a ruling, but the shipped objection is substantively strong and specific, and paced breathing altering HRV is well documented. The author should rule on this before Part Three is internally consistent with the counterfeiting discussion in Chapter Seven, which already concedes that gaming is unsolved.

Confounds. The shipped paragraph also named medication, disability, illness, fatigue, environment, and culture as affecting the same signals. The baseline names none of them, and the volume card lists neurodivergence claims and population baselining among the volume's known concerns. Whether that list belongs in this chapter or in the streams chapters is the author's call; it was not merged here because it arrived as part of the contradicting paragraph.
Priority claim. For the first time in human history is restored in the display line. CTD-0004 exists for this phrase.

Heading. What the Body Reveals That the Will Cannot Conceal names the claim. What the Body Contributes names a contribution and commits to nothing, which is exactly what the shipped section did. Not changed. Renaming costs a section id and a recorded route alias in publishing/continuity.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, editorial/sources/corpus/voice-card.md, the volume-03 voice card, the master ledger, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required, and the three carried methods all fire in this one section. Substitution by adjacent truth, in its clearest instance. The cautious half law, fourth confirmation in Part Three, with the committing half being the section's own title. And the heading diagnostic pointing at the same deletion. That convergence is itself the evidence: three independent tests locate the same two sentences, which is what a real pattern looks like rather than three descriptions of one anecdote.
